ChiselTeam / Projects

Tools for better surfaces.

Our player-facing building mod and rendering library are developed together, but each project has a clear job and can evolve on its own.

Chisel-3Application

Expands familiar Minecraft materials into large families of decorative variants. Players can convert blocks through a visual menu, work directly in the world with selectable modes, automate bulk conversions, and lay out complex builds with dedicated tools.

CTMLibrary

Provides custom NeoForge blockstate models for connected, directional, layered, multiblock, anti-repeat, emissive, and conditionally overlaid textures. Mods can author definitions directly in JSON or generate them through the Java API.

Shared principles

Modern, focused, interoperable.

Both projects target NeoForge 26.1.2, keep public integration surfaces intentionally small, and use standard data resources wherever that is the cleanest extension point.

Data where it fits

Tags extend Chisel families. JSON defines CTM behavior. Java remains available when an integration needs runtime logic.

Clear ownership

Addons retain ownership of their blocks and resources. Chisel and CTM provide the relationships and rendering systems.

Built in the open

Both repositories are GPL-3.0 licensed and accept focused bug fixes, documentation, translations, and discussed features.
